mapper.sql: id, username, password, display_name, email, avatar_url, signature, signature_pending, signature_status, role, active, last_food_upload_at, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM app_user ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET signature_pending = #{signature}, signature_status = 'PENDING' WHERE username = #{username} AND active = TRUE
UPDATE app_user SET signature = signature_pending, signature_pending = NULL, signature_status = 'APPROVED' WHERE id = #{id} AND signature_status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE app_user SET signature_status = 'REJECTED' WHERE id = #{id} AND signature_status = 'PENDING'
